baslik: How Was the Red Sea Locked 471 Years Ago? ⚓ Ozdemir Pasha (1555) #shorts
aciklama:
Today, disruptions around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait affect 12% of global maritime trade, forcing cargo ships to sail around Africa. Yet 471 years ago, in 1555, the exact same struggle took place at the exact same gate.

Sent by Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent, Ottoman commander Ozdemir Pasha marched down the Nile cataracts, fortified Suakin Island, captured Massawa in 1557, established the Province of Habesh, and locked the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from both shores against the Portuguese fleet.
